title: Primitive Sequences for Probability Measures on Compact Intervals
summary: We introduce a sequence representation of a random variable $X$ supported on a compact interval $[a,b]$, which we call a primitive sequence. We construct this sequence by repeatedly antidifferentiating the associated cumulative distribution function of $X$ and evaluating the antiderivatives at the endpoint $b$. We show that the primitive sequence of $X$ can be identified as a factorially rescaled moment sequence of the reflected random variable $b-X$.
